name: JellyFetch
description: Automatically scrapes, orchestrates cloud downloads, and injects them directly into your Jellyfin library. Fully automatic UI install - no manual web file setup required.
overview: A powerful plugin built for Indian users (with 1tamilmv integration) to seamlessly download and organize media.

versions.changelog: v1.1.0: Initial Official Release. Automated regional media scraping (1tamilmv), multi-provider cloud downloading (Seedr & Torbox), native movie details integration with real-time percentage progress, and automatic clean uninstallation.
